investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Keswave Ride (ride-hailing); Platform: Google Cloud southamerica-east1 (zones southamerica-east1-a/southamerica-east1-b/southamerica-east1-c); network range 10.203.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster keswav-prod-southa (GKE); Identity/token service token-svc is called synchronously by every API request and is backed by PostgreSQL token-db-01; deployments may bundle database migrations; Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
